content.text: {"headline":"Approve P1: delay breaks by 30 minutes and move one cross-skilled agent from payments to general (14:00-15:00), at no cost.","why":"The login outage (INC-20261024-1535) is resolved and call volume is returning to plan (54 calls vs 49.8 forecast at 13:30). Even with no action we are already above the 80% target for 13:45-15:45 (90.1%). P1 lifts this to 91.5% at no extra cost. General improves to 98.1%, abandon rate eases to 2.2%, and rest-of-day service level rises to 94.4%. No policy issues and no escalation needed.","trade_offs":["Payments dips slightly to 86.4% (from 87.5% with no action) because one agent moves to general. This is still comfortably above target.","P4 (chat deflection plus callback) predicts 91.6%, essentially the same, but costs INR 24 and adds customer-facing changes. P1 gets the same result for free.","P2 (IVR outage message) is also free and protects payments better (87.2%), but reaches only 91.0% overall. The outage is resolved, so a known-issue message may confuse callers.","P3 (overtime for 3 general agents) costs INR 360 and predicts a lower 90.8%. Not worth it.","Doing nothing (P0) also meets target at 90.1%. P1 is a small, free improvement and a buffer if late outage calls continue."],"watch":"Keep an eye on login_issue calls on general and on payments service level during 14:00-15:00 while the agent is moved. If payments drops noticeably or volume rises again (e.g. the outage recurs), move the agent back and review the plan."}
